note: The ORIGINAL Serum (v1, distinct from Serum 2). Captured LIVE from the installed plugin hosted in Ableton Live (Mosh's in-process host crashes on Serum 1; Ableton hosts it fine and accepts tab clicks). Init patch, dark skin. 4 tabs (OSC/FX/MATRIX/GLOBAL — no MIX, vs Serum 2's 5); active tab marked by a BLUE dot. ENV 1 ADSR (ATTACK/HOLD/DECAY/SUSTAIN/RELEASE — no DELAY). White-pointer knobs; the reader is skin-relative. Coords in reference_size space; load_profile scales to any frame.
